title_en: Priority area 7: Do No Harm, Put Safety First
objectives_fil: Makinig sa ligtas at pribadong lugar, sundin ang lokal na protection pathway, at itala lamang ang awtorisadong detalye.
Ibahagi ang nasuring safety action at ituro kung saan kukumpirmahin ang kasalukuyang dokumento at benepisyo.
Gumawa ng malinaw na nasuring prevention message at ilagay ang tamang urgent-care contact.
Tukuyin ang tiyak na panganib, ibahagi ang ligtas na kilos, at ipasa ang concern sa angkop na barangay partner.
objectives_en: Given a disclosure or observation, respond privately and connect to the locally verified protection/health pathway.
Given an older resident's concern, explain a reviewed safety action and where to verify entitlements.
Given a seasonal campaign, give an approved prevention and urgent-care message.
Given a pedestrian/rider risk scene, propose a practical prevention and community-reporting action.
summary_fil: Huwag manakit, unahin ang kaligtasan: 4 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Priority area 7: Do No Harm, Put Safety First: 4 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
